# cybersecurity.codes

> A parody site: the "Global Cybersecurity Code Authority" issues the official daily codes that control everything cybersecurity, worldwide. New codes at 00:00 UTC every day. The authority does not exist and the codes control nothing.

cybersecurity.codes is satire of security theatre and secret-code culture. Each day it displays a fresh set of classified-looking codes with a countdown to the next issue. The codes are derived from the UTC date, so every visitor on Earth sees the same ones — which, the site notes, is exactly how real global security works. There is no backend, no cookies and no tracking or analytics script; the codes are computed in the browser. The page does load its VT323 typeface from Google Fonts, and the CDN keeps standard access logs that are used only for overall visitor statistics. Please do not fax the codes to your government.

Technical: static site, MIT licensed, installable PWA that works fully offline (the codes are computed from the date client-side).

## Links
